title: Why it sucks being a goalkeeper

scenes.text: Why it sucks being a goalkeeper.
It starts when you're six. Everyone wants to score. You're the slowest kid on the team. So the coach puts you in goal.
Age eight. Forty minutes. Nothing happens. You're freezing. Nobody passes to you.
After the game, your dad asks: "Did you save anything?" You touched the ball twice.
Age eleven. You make ten saves. You still lose 1-0.
Age thirteen. A shot from five yards. You save it... with your face. Everyone laughs.
Age fifteen. Training ends. The others play five-a-side. You? Thirty crosses. In the rain. Alone.
Age seventeen. Ninetieth minute. 1-0 up. Easy catch... and it slips through your gloves.
That's the thing about being a goalkeeper. A striker misses ten chances, scores one... and he's a hero.
You make ten saves, drop one... and you're the villain.
Tag your goalkeeper. Tell them thank you.
